# v0.6.19

## Changes

### Bug Fixes
- Fix notification bell to only show when a newer build is available
- Fix notification persistence after installing latest build without restart
- Add empty signature field required by Tauri update schema
- Disable signature verification for native updater

### Maintenance
- Remove dead code: useCheckNewBuilds hook, useIsTerminalRunning, terminal stubs
- Clean up debug logging statements
